headline: Canada readjusts its ties with China and seeks an adequate deal with US: Carney
summary: Canada and China are taking steps to expand access for financial companies to their respective markets, Prime Minister Mark Carney said. He also said Canada is seeking a suitable agreement with the United States.
why: Canada is a major trading economy whose trade ties with China and the US shape investment and export outlooks. Market access for banks and financial firms is a concrete measure of bilateral economic relations.
original_headline: Canadá reajusta sus lazos con China y busca un acuerdo adecuado con EU: Carney
